caption: The drawing depicts a wooden candle sconce, rendered in shades of brown and orange. The sconce has a rectangular base and two curved sides that rise vertically, meeting the back panel, which extends upward with a rounded top. There is a circular hole near the top center of the back panel, presumably for hanging. The sconce sits on a plain, light beige background. Below the illustration, the words "Candle Sconce" are printed in gray, centered text. The entire drawing is centered on the page, with a handwritten number "36" in the bottom left corner and a small signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Shaker Candle Sconce
